facts.text: Built an Android stock-tracking app for his family's pharmacy: scan the barcode on a medicine strip and the stock updates.
Wrote all of it himself: the Kotlin app and the Firebase backend. Nobody else coded.
Three pharmacy staff use it every day.
Monthly write-offs of expired medicines fell from about 12,000 rupees to about 2,000.
Won second place out of 140 teams at a state-level hackathon in Pune in 2025 with that app.
Led four students building a timetable app, with weekly sprints and a demo every Friday.
They shipped in 10 weeks and the college now uses it for 600 students.
Wants to work on payments for small merchants because he watched his father reconcile UPI payments by hand every night.
